description: Lithium Research Vault - headline snapshot for any lithium and battery metals mining company or producing mine. One row: latest production, volume-weighted AISC, realized price, cash/debt/EBITDA/FCF, reserves, top holder, source filing. Primary-source data on 40 producers (hardrock spodumene + brine) and 49 mines, e.g. Albemarle, Pilbara, SQM, Greenbushes, Atacama. Searchable by ticker (ALB, SQM, SGML) or mine name. Cheapest tier; /vault for full rows, /vault/story for narrative.
